whatsNext.note: An estimate from the log and age. Every child is different.

healthHints.title: Worth noticing
healthHints.note: General information from public health sites, not an assessment of your child.

feverYoung.title: Fever of {temperature} °C in a baby under 3 months
feverYoung.body: Contact a doctor or the out-of-hours service (116 117) right away when a baby under 3 months has a fever. If the baby is limp, hard to wake or has trouble breathing, call 113.

lowTemperatureYoung.title: Low temperature: {temperature} °C
lowTemperatureYoung.body: Contact a doctor or the out-of-hours service (116 117) if a baby under 3 months has a temperature under 35 °C. If the baby is limp or hard to wake, call 113.

feverVeryHigh.title: High fever: {temperature} °C
feverVeryHigh.body: Contact your GP or the out-of-hours service (116 117) for a very high fever, especially if the child is limp, will not drink or the fever does not come down. If the child has a rash that does not fade when pressed, or is hard to wake, call 113.

feverLong.title: Fever for at least {days} days
feverLong.body: Contact a doctor if the child has had a fever for more than three days, or is limp or will not drink.

wetDiapers.title: Few wet diapers in the last 24 hours
wetDiapers.body: You have logged {count, plural, =0 {no wet diapers} one {# wet diaper} other {# wet diapers}} in the last 24 hours. From about day 5, {min} or more wet diapers a day is a good sign that a newborn gets enough milk. Not every diaper may be logged. Contact the child health clinic or your GP if you are worried, or the out-of-hours service (116 117) outside opening hours.

feedingGap.title: Over {hours} hours since the last feed
feedingGap.body: It is longer than usual since the last feed, and young babies feed often, around 8 to 12 times a day in the first weeks. A feed may not be logged. Contact the child health clinic or the out-of-hours service (116 117) if the baby will not eat, is limp or is hard to wake.
